apps.name: Dispatcher
apps.description: Schedule outbound pickups and inbound arrivals, track load progress, and view daily timelines.
apps.releaseNotes:
Dispatcher 1.1.7

View BOL now downloads and opens the published PDF inside Dispatcher, including on phones without a PDF viewer. An animated spinner replaces the button label until the first page is ready. PDFs support page navigation and pinch or double-tap zoom. Failed downloads restore the button for retry; temporary files are removed when the viewer closes.

Simplifies the Set Custom Carrier dialog by removing the extra explanatory labels. The five-letter SCAC limit remains enforced.

apps.name: MES Radio
apps.description: Push-to-talk for your MES team. Talk on radio channels and replay received voice.
apps.releaseNotes:
SIGNING KEY REPLACED: this release cannot update the old installation. Uninstall the old app first, which deletes its local settings, drafts and recordings, then install this version and sign in again. The package ID is unchanged. Server-side records are not deleted by uninstalling.

mes-walkie-talkie 1.0.8

Rebuilt from the latest pulled MES source on September 23, 2026. Retains the existing package ID with the owner-approved replacement signing key.
Includes the pending nearby-audio correction: a one-meter range, location accuracy accounted for, a stable decision per message, and a minimum live gain of 0.5. Recordings and Replay retain their existing behavior. Precise nearby ranging remains dependent on device location accuracy.

MES Run Beta 25

Redesigned stop form with gray reason codes, searchable reasons and separate notes.
Add camera or gallery photos to unplanned stops. Confirm uploads photos first, with circular percentage progress on each thumbnail, then saves the stop. Failed uploads can be retried.
Photos are stored as WebP in Dropbox and linked to the stop in production history.
Uses the production MES service. Sign in with your existing authorized supervisor PIN.

apps.name: Upkeep Beta
apps.description: Test reporting, repairs, parts approvals, preventive maintenance and inspections with mock data only.
apps.releaseNotes:
Upkeep 0.1.0-beta.10 - bold, minimal UI refinement

Reviewed with Impeccable using independent design and implementation assessments.
Purchase pages now use one primary footer action. Repeated PIN, report-progress, menu and photo-stack instructions have been reduced while required labels and consequences remain visible.
History opens with records; Search and Filters reveal controls on demand, with active filters visible and easy to clear.
Unfinished purchase inputs now survive rotation and returning to the form within the session. Invalid fields show local errors and focus the first correction. Purchase metadata is quieter; page headings expose native accessibility semantics.

Demo PIN: 1234. Sample data only. Photos and unfinished inputs remain session-only; closing the process or resetting the demo clears them.
